expectations: Activates the sagemaker-domain-vpc-iac skill and queries live ap-south-1 SageMaker Domains, VPCs/subnets/endpoints, and `ap-south-1` PrivateLink endpoint services exclusively via connected MCP tools without running raw `aws` CLI shell commands

evals.prompt: An engineer wrote AWS CDK TypeScript using `new sagemaker.Domain(...)` and `new sagemaker.UserProfile(...)` with `authMode: 'IAM'` while also setting `singleSignOnUserIdentifier: 'UserName'` and `singleSignOnUserValue: 'alice'`. Fix the CDK constructs and `AuthMode` bug, and validate the resulting CloudFormation template via MCP compliance tools.
evals.expected_output: Fixes both bugs: (1) `aws-cdk-lib/aws-sagemaker` has **NO L2 Studio constructs** — must use L1 `CfnDomain`, `CfnUserProfile`, and `CfnSpace` (never `new sagemaker.Domain` / `UserProfile`); (2) `authMode: 'IAM'` **must omit** `singleSignOnUserIdentifier` and `singleSignOnUserValue` (which are mutually exclusive and valid only when `authMode: 'SSO'` with IAM Identity Center enabled!). Validates the synthesized/equivalent CloudFormation template via `awsiac` MCP (`validate_cloudformation_template` / `check_cloudformation_template_compliance`).
expectations: Activates the sagemaker-domain-vpc-iac skill and validates the CloudFormation template using `awsiac` MCP (`validate_cloudformation_template` and/or `check_cloudformation_template_compliance`)
Explains the CDK L1-only rule (`CfnDomain`, `CfnUserProfile`, `CfnSpace` — `aws-cdk-lib/aws-sagemaker` has no L2 `Domain`/`UserProfile` constructs)
Catches the `authMode: 'IAM'` vs `SSO` mutual-exclusivity bug (omitting `singleSignOnUserIdentifier` and `singleSignOnUserValue` when `authMode: 'IAM'`)

evals.prompt: Our `appNetworkAccessType: 'VpcOnly'` SageMaker Studio Domain in private subnets (zero NAT Gateway) fails to mount user home directories or launch Spark/KernelGateway Spaces because our Domain Security Group has `0` inbound rules and our VPC only has an S3 Gateway Endpoint. List the exact missing PrivateLink endpoints and Security Group rules.
evals.expected_output: Specifies all mandatory `VpcOnly` network controls across `>= 2` private AZ subnets: (1) **1 Gateway Endpoint** (`s3`) + **7 mandatory Interface Endpoints** (`privateDnsEnabled: true`: `sagemaker.api`, `sagemaker.runtime`, `sagemaker.studio`, `ecr.api`, `ecr.dkr`, `sts`, `logs`, plus optional `kms`/`ssm`/`bedrock-runtime`); (2) **Domain Security Group self-referencing ingress** on **TCP `2049`** (NFS for Domain EFS `HomeEfsFileSystemUid` mounts) AND **TCP `8192–65535`** (inter-container / KernelGateway / Spark); (3) **VPCE Security Group** allowing inbound TCP `443` from the Domain SG (`allowAllOutbound: false`).
expectations: Activates the sagemaker-domain-vpc-iac skill
Lists the `s3` Gateway Endpoint and all 7 mandatory Interface Endpoints (`sagemaker.api`, `sagemaker.runtime`, `sagemaker.studio`, `ecr.api`, `ecr.dkr`, `sts`, `logs` with `privateDnsEnabled: true`)
Specifies the self-referencing Domain Security Group ingress rules on **TCP `2049`** (NFS/EFS) and **TCP `8192–65535`** (KernelGateway/Spark/inter-container) plus TCP `443` to the VPCE Security Group

evals.prompt: In CloudFormation (`AWS::SageMaker::Space`), our platform team tried creating a **`Shared` `CodeEditor`** Space (with `ownershipSettings` set) and left idle shutdown disabled. Why did CloudFormation reject the Space, and what exact `CfnSpace` sharing + idle lifecycle settings are required?
evals.expected_output: Explains both `CfnSpace` rules: (1) **`CodeEditor`** ONLY supports `sharingType: 'Private'` (with mandatory `ownershipSettings: { ownerUserProfileName }`), whereas **`JupyterLab`** supports `'Private'` OR `'Shared'` (and when `'Shared'`, **`ownershipSettings` MUST be omitted**!); (2) configure `appLifecycleManagement.idleSettings` (`idleTimeoutInMinutes: 60`, `minIdleTimeoutInMinutes: 60`, `maxIdleTimeoutInMinutes: 240`) to prevent 24/7 orphaned compute waste.
expectations: Activates the sagemaker-domain-vpc-iac skill
Explains that `CodeEditor` only supports `sharingType: 'Private'` (requiring `ownershipSettings`), whereas `Shared` Spaces are supported on `JupyterLab` and **must omit `ownershipSettings`**
Configures `idleSettings` (`idleTimeoutInMinutes: 60`, `minIdleTimeoutInMinutes: 60`, `maxIdleTimeoutInMinutes: 240`)

evals.prompt: Currently every user and job in our Studio Domain shares `AmazonSageMakerFullAccess`. Refactor this into the 5-persona least-privilege IAM role architecture, including the exact IAM `Condition` keys that force data scientists to run Training/Processing jobs inside our VPC with KMS encryption while blocking production `CreateEndpoint`.
evals.expected_output: Replaces `AmazonSageMakerFullAccess` with the **5-Persona IAM Architecture**: (1) `StudioDomainExecutionRole`, (2) `DataScientistProfileRole` (enforcing `Null: {"sagemaker:VpcSubnets": "false", "sagemaker:VpcSecurityGroupIds": "false", "sagemaker:VolumeKmsKey": "false"}` on `CreateTrainingJob`/`CreateProcessingJob` and explicit `Deny` on `sagemaker:CreateEndpoint` / `UpdateEndpoint` in prod), (3) `TrainingJobExecutionRole`, (4) `PipelineExecutionRole` (`iam:PassRole` gated by `iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com`), and (5) `EndpointInferenceRole` (minimal model S3 RO + KMS Decrypt + Logs, zero training-data access).
expectations: Activates the sagemaker-domain-vpc-iac skill

Defines all 5 distinct IAM personas (`StudioDomainExecutionRole`, `DataScientistProfileRole`, `TrainingJobExecutionRole`, `PipelineExecutionRole` with `iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com`, and `EndpointInferenceRole`)

Includes the `Null: false` condition keys (`sagemaker:VpcSubnets`, `sagemaker:VpcSecurityGroupIds`, `sagemaker:VolumeKmsKey`) and explicit `Deny` on `CreateEndpoint`/`UpdateEndpoint` for `DataScientistProfileRole`

evals.prompt: Data scientists built a 12 GB custom Studio Docker image from `ubuntu:22.04` running as `root` (`UID 0`) and complain that launching a Space takes 8 minutes and crashes with EFS permission errors. Prescribe the production BYOI Dockerfile, `CfnImage`/`CfnAppImageConfig`, and fast container pull pattern.
evals.expected_output: Fixes the BYOI image: base off `public.ecr.aws/sagemaker/sagemaker-distribution:latest-cpu` (or `-gpu`), run as non-root `sagemaker-user` (**`UID 1000` / `GID 100`**) matching `FileSystemConfig` (`DefaultUid: 1000`, `DefaultGid: 100`, `MountPath: /home/sagemaker-user`) in `CfnAppImageConfig`, register via `CfnImage` + `CfnImageVersion`, and build/push an **AWS SOCI index** (`soci create` / `soci push`) for lazy-loading 5–15 GB images in seconds.
expectations: Activates the sagemaker-domain-vpc-iac skill

Requires `UID 1000` / `GID 100` (`sagemaker-user`, never `root` `UID 0`) with `CfnAppImageConfig` (`KernelGatewayImageConfig.FileSystemConfig` `DefaultUid: 1000` / `DefaultGid: 100` or modern `JupyterLabAppImageConfig` / `CodeEditorAppImageConfig` `ContainerConfig`) and recommends `sagemaker-distribution` base images
Prescribes **AWS SOCI** (`soci create` / `soci push`) lazy-loading indexes alongside `CfnImage` / `CfnImageVersion`

evals.prompt: Our organization uses Amazon Cognito / Okta OIDC rather than AWS IAM Identity Center (`SSO`), and wants users to sign into a web portal and land directly inside their isolated SageMaker Studio UserProfile without AWS Console credentials. Design the authentication architecture.
evals.expected_output: Configures `CfnDomain` in `authMode: 'IAM'` (omitting SSO attributes), fronts an API Gateway HTTP/REST endpoint with a Cognito/OIDC JWT Authorizer, and invokes a scoped Lambda that maps the verified user claim to their `UserProfileName` and calls `sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl` (e.g., `ExpiresInSeconds=300` single-use short-lived URL, `SessionExpirationDurationInSeconds=43200` max 12h session).
expectations: Activates the sagemaker-domain-vpc-iac skill
Uses `authMode: 'IAM'` on `CfnDomain` paired with an API Gateway JWT Authorizer + Lambda calling `sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl`
Specifies short presigned URL expiry (`ExpiresInSeconds`, e.g., `300s`) and bounded session duration (`SessionExpirationDurationInSeconds <= 43200`)

evals.prompt: Audit a Studio CloudFormation template that sets `KmsKeyId` on `AWS::SageMaker::Domain` for the shared EFS volume, omits `VolumeKmsKeyId` / `EbsStorageSettings` encryption controls, disables `DefaultUserSettings` `SecurityGroups`, and leaves Studio lifecycle scripts pulling pip packages directly over the public internet.
evals.expected_output: Hardens encryption and air-gapped supply chain: attaches a customer-managed KMS CMK (`EnableKeyRotation: true`, key policy granting `sagemaker.amazonaws.com` and execution roles via `kms:ViaService`) across Domain EFS (`KmsKeyId`), Space/Training/Processing EBS volumes, and S3 artifact buckets; enforces `DefaultUserSettings.SecurityGroups` in `VpcOnly` mode; and routes `pip`/`conda` installs to AWS CodeArtifact (via PrivateLink) or pre-baked BYOI images rather than public internet egress.
expectations: Activates the sagemaker-domain-vpc-iac skill
Enforces KMS CMK encryption (`EnableKeyRotation: true`) across Domain EFS, Space/Job EBS volumes, and S3 buckets alongside explicit `DefaultUserSettings.SecurityGroups`
Replaces public-internet `pip` lifecycle installs in `VpcOnly` mode with AWS CodeArtifact PrivateLink or pre-baked BYOI images
